verdict.rationale: Missive confirms a native Rules feature ("Automate your workflows", "Up to 1000 rules", and documentation referencing 'how to set up a rule') that lets users define automation triggered by events, plus webhooks/API for event-driven actions. However, the evidence pack lacks concrete documentation of what trigger events or actions rules support, no hands-on examples of rule configuration, and no independent corroboration of automation depth or reliability. missing for 10: detailed rule trigger/action catalog, hands-on walkthrough of rule creation, independent user validation of automation reliability.
